01.identity: Eyes closed in combat; violet bat hood and ornate bow. Listen, mark and decide when precision is worth consuming the setup.
01.tradeoff: Holding a Mark supports resource income; spending it changes the payoff. Wounds offer a separate route.

02.identity: Short-haired, tougher young face, simple headwear and red scarf. Courage comes from choosing an answer after manual defence.
02.tradeoff: Spend Grit on protection or reserve it for a decisive sword response; timing remains manual.

03.identity: Retain supplied orange-haired Pip reference. Cultivate fire, accelerate its payoff or convert it into shelter and cold.
03.tradeoff: Early detonation sacrifices future fire ticks. Every release clears the consumed source.

04.equipment: Maintenance staff + lamp-service tome (tome compatibility proposed)
04.identity: Elderly practical lamplighter with liked coat/face. Prepare one light; carry it safely or shutter it into a deliberate strike.
04.tradeoff: A protected low-oil rhythm competes with spending the prepared lamp for immediate pressure.

05.equipment: Two-handed combat axe (future category; not gathering Woodaxe)
05.identity: Broad woodcutter, exposed forearms, pine colours. The axe engraving must rotate with its blade and match the close-up.
05.tradeoff: Spend early to brace, aim for the exact-three Grain cut or reserve five for a larger fall.

06.identity: Keep Maren's liked face and bone/charcoal/bronze. Short intact mantle with few broad memorial strips, minimal shredding.
06.tradeoff: Retain Ward to sustain sword work or surrender protection for rebuke; manual defence funds remembrance.

07.identity: Mature knight, silver plate, crimson cloth, key/oath seal. Default design removes the banner; no flag equipment category.
07.tradeoff: Declare a commitment, fulfil it on another chosen action or release the vow for safety.

08.equipment: Two-handed Combat Spear (future category; distinct from Hunting Spear)
08.identity: Keep mountain veteran and pale steel/ochre. Held spear, narrow split coat, no flight or spear throw.
08.tradeoff: Keep Long reach for penetration or enter Close for protected haft contact, then pay to step out.

09.equipment: Reed staff + water-reading tome (tome compatibility proposed)
09.identity: Keep liked reed staff, reduce foliage and diversify face. Water readings reflect completed moves, never unseen future attacks.
09.tradeoff: Retain a reading for protection or release it into reflection damage; cold adds a different control route.

11.identity: Keep broad quarry worker, short square maul and slate/chalk/rust apron. Strong heavy female identity without a shield.
11.tradeoff: Open intact defences first or build Load for an impact while the foe is already open.

12.equipment: Dagger + compact sigil folio (future categories/class eligibility)
12.identity: Keep Isolde's close-quarter identity; make Seal magic explicit. Short intact cloak. The original prop was a contract case, not proof of implemented magic.
12.tradeoff: Let a contract wound accrue, close the Seal for an opening or preserve wounds while controlling the foe.

13.equipment: Star-sliver staff + Starcaller tome (tome compatibility proposed)
13.identity: Keep favourite midnight-blue/cream design, diversify face. Held charts become a recognisable tome, with star charts inside.
13.tradeoff: Schedule one impact and wait, pull it early at reduced strength or cancel it for protection.

16.equipment: Ceremonial light staff + sacred tome (class compatibility proposed)
16.identity: Cleaner elegant ceremonial cloth and luminous detail. Retain Saint/Last Lantern lore; literal goddess status is unconfirmed.
16.tradeoff: Use a steady small-light window or hold a brighter reserve for a costly burst.

17.identity: Keep charred plate and ember seams; cleaner cloak, fewer leg rags and broad waist cloth. Carried lantern remains distinct from Heat.
17.tradeoff: Hold Heat for offensive pressure, risk opening the plate or vent the reserve into safety; being hit is never required.

18.equipment: Two-handed duelling blade (future Ranger melee eligibility)
18.identity: Keep older restrained Corvin; plain belt and cleaner court coat. Attached contract/oath seal is identity detail, not a free combat slot.
18.tradeoff: Prepare an Opening, spend it on an answer or refuse it to recover Freedom.

19.equipment: Two-handed hooked Combat Spear/harpoon variant (future category)
19.identity: Keep coastal Cass, simplify weapon bulk and shells. Rope stays attached; no thrown harpoon or compulsory second handheld prop.
19.tradeoff: Keep venom and the sounding mark working or consume setup for penetration and safer follow-up.

23.equipment: Glass-focus staff + workshop tome (tome compatibility proposed)
23.identity: Distinct face from Pip. Apron, cooling motifs and visibly glass focus, not a fire orb or physical thrown shards.
23.tradeoff: Leave Chill to mature into control or anneal a layer into an opening; preserve or spend protective glass.

27.identity: Cropped mountain cloak and cairn charm. Complete bow/string geometry. Patient surveying contrasts with Wren's listening precision.
27.tradeoff: Keep Pin while poison works or consume the sign for a clear shot; poison stacks have finite duration.

28.identity: Broad visibly powerful adult woman, practical heavy plate and square weather cloak. Hip lantern; old brazier retained in her history. Blunt hospitality: Come inside. I'll hold this.
28.tradeoff: Keep the shield planted for protection or surrender the position and its Guard to release a heavier sword strike.

29.equipment: Auger staff + Starscar survey tome (tome compatibility proposed)
29.identity: Preserve favourite Inga design, calipers and earthy survey colours. Tome has layered cross-sections and measuring tabs; reduce orbital cage similarity to Oriel.
29.tradeoff: Preserve Sunder for penetration or spend an exposed layer to excavate cold underneath.

30.equipment: Hooked frost-glass staff + recipe tome (tome compatibility proposed)
30.identity: Reduce foliage and remove staff bell. Colder witch colours, small sealed focus and closed belt kettle; clearly mature face.
30.tradeoff: Let venom mature, reduce it for damage or dilute it for cover while buying separate frost treatment.
